name: FunPV: Cosy FPV Experience
detailed_description:
What if you could fly freely with an FPV drone in a world covered in water?

FunPV is a first-person view (FPV) drone simulator. Freely fly in exoplanet open world ! Explore a town on stilts and white stone cliffs ! Alone or online, join public lobbies and fly through the skies with other players!

Enjoy FunPV with a standard gamepad, or use your real FPV Drone controller as the DJI RC3. Practice in our virtual worlds and familiarize yourself with your drone's controls before using it in real life !

Not yet comfortable ? FPV isn't your cup of tea ? Or you just want to fly in a more relaxed way? A classic camera drone is also available! Two control modes are available : the former, Classic Mode is more demanding but akin to the real controls of a real camera drone. The latter is an Arcade Mode inspired by the usual controls you can find with flying vehicles in most video games (helicopter, etc).

Key features:

  • A world designed for exploration and uncovering passages to perform tricks in the air

  • 3D Pixel Art graphics with warm, vibrant colours

  • Two choices of drone to suit your mood

  • Fully customisable controls, using a joystick or specialized radio FPV controllers

  • Fly alongside other players online and be inspired by their best tricks !

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050, AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Additional Notes: You can use DJI RC 3 or Beta FPV Radio-Controller
